correctness.rationale: After edge subdivision every link type with at most \(N\) sticks can be represented with exactly \(N\) vertices. A labeled cyclic component decomposition is encoded by a permutation with cycle lengths at least three. Relabeling coordinate slots by \(\tau\) conjugates the permutation by \(\tau\sigma\tau^{-1}\) and induces an isomorphism of the corresponding wall arrangement, so one representative per conjugacy class suffices for ordinary unlabeled links. Conjugacy classes of permutations are exactly cycle types, hence restricted integer partitions of \(N\). The source's fixed-decomposition chamber estimate is uniform and equals \((AN)^{3N}\), so summing over \(p_{\ge3}(N)\) models proves the finite bound; Hardy--Ramanujan gives the subexponential partition factor. The verifier exhaustively confirms the cycle-type/restricted-partition quotient through \(N=9\).

final_claim: For ordinary unoriented unordered polygonal links with at most \(N\) total sticks, quotienting labeled cyclic component decompositions by relabeling gives \(|\mathcal L_N|\le p_{\ge3}(N)(AN)^{3N}=N^{3N+o(N)}\).
